protocol.question: Does optimizing O through the exact headwise ridge alignment preserve its class-facing residual effect after AGA and B replacement?
protocol.construction: One rank-nine O update starting at the original parent, in the same public readout class-contrast space. On the same 400 even-image views minimize the equal mean of the normalized squared class residual in ordinary TA and AGA-then-TA. For O in the AGA case use the exact differentiable FP64 headwise ridge formula with the pinned 1e-8 regularizer. The other attention tensors are independent of O under the author kernel and cached from the parent. Constrain the O update norm by the parent O norm. Use standard LBFGS with a fixed 20-iteration, 30-evaluation library budget and ordinary line search. Apply the preceding one-solve B fit for the native and ordinary TA features, with unchanged norm cap.
protocol.validation: Check directional derivative before fitting, and compare the analytical O with actual author output at the parent and the frozen point. Report all five predeclared 400-view rows and actual AGA. Gate: retain native within two, no increase in raw TA or AGA, fewer matches after both direct and AGA B replacements. Fit and freeze before held-out scoring. Prior outcome observed on the odd images, so this is a fixed source diagnostic.
protocol.scope: No partners or real images in construction. One finite source point, no amplification of the closed O or parameter sweep. Primary natural evaluation follows only after source eligibility.
